caseName: Florida Prepaid Postsecondary Education Expense Board v. College Savings Bank
caseNameFull: Florida Prepaid Postsecondary Education Expense Board v. College Savings Bank

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. Motion of Regents of the University of California for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, February 22,1999. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, March 24, 1999. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 12, 1999. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
